scenes.name: launcher-chat
scenes.caption: Launcher chat — the seeded demo conversation opens in the overlay itself.
scenes.narration: Ask in place — your conversations live in the overlay, no window switch.

scenes.name: launcher
scenes.caption: The hotkey launcher — summon the assistant from anywhere, ask, dismiss.
scenes.narration: One hotkey summons the assistant over anything you are doing.

scenes.name: launcher-calc
scenes.caption: Mini tool — the calculator evaluates live as you type in the launcher.
scenes.narration: Mini tools turn the input into a focused surface — the calculator answers as you type.

scenes.name: launcher-translate
scenes.caption: Mini tool — the translate pad renders a live translation (local demo engine).
scenes.narration: The translate pad renders live output — ask in one language, get another.

scenes.name: desktop-chat
scenes.caption: Desktop window — full conversations with the seeded demo history.
scenes.narration: Open the window and your conversations are there — markdown, math, spoken replies.

scenes.name: desktop-tools
scenes.caption: Tool trace — a conversation where the assistant ran tools and wrote a file artifact.
scenes.narration: When tools run, you see every step — what was called, what came back, what was produced.

scenes.name: settings-general
scenes.caption: Settings — general pane of the settings window.
scenes.narration: Everything is configurable — appearance, behavior, startup.

scenes.name: settings-api
scenes.caption: Settings — AI provider setup (BYOK).
scenes.narration: Bring your own key: your AI provider, your data, your machine.
